# MySupportInfo

> One Link to Diagnose Any Device. Instant client-side browser, network, and hardware diagnostics for remote teams, IT helpdesks, and developers with zero tracking.

## Overview
MySupportInfo (https://mysupportinfo.com) is a free, 100% in-browser device diagnostic and network intelligence platform. It allows users, IT technicians, sysadmins, and support agents to inspect comprehensive hardware, browser, and network specifications in under 3 seconds without downloading software, configuring agents, or creating an account.

## Key Diagnostic Tools
- **What Is My Browser (https://mysupportinfo.com/what-is-my-browser):** Detects browser engine, exact major and minor version, user agent string, JavaScript capability, cookie persistence, and client hints.
- **What Is My IP Address (https://mysupportinfo.com/what-is-my-ip):** Real-time IPv4 and IPv6 detection, ISP organization name, autonomous system (ASN), approximate geolocation, and WebRTC privacy leak audits.
- **What Is My Screen Size (https://mysupportinfo.com/what-is-my-screen-resolution):** Physical monitor resolution, active CSS viewport dimensions, Device Pixel Ratio (DPR), 24-bit/30-bit color depth, and screen orientation.
- **Bufferbloat Latency Test (https://mysupportinfo.com/bufferbloat):** Measures network latency and jitter under heavy loaded download and upload conditions, issuing a letter grade from A to F to diagnose lag in gaming, video calls, and streaming.
- **Reporting & Export Suite:** Generates 1-click encrypted shareable links, visual PNG diagnostic cards for support tickets, and RFC-4180 compliant CSV exports.

## Direct Answers to Common Queries
- **What is my browser?** You can find your exact browser and version at https://mysupportinfo.com/what-is-my-browser.
- **What is my IP?** Discover your public IPv4, IPv6, ISP, and WebRTC leak status at https://mysupportinfo.com/what-is-my-ip.
- **How to test for bufferbloat?** Run a loaded latency diagnostic at https://mysupportinfo.com/bufferbloat to see if network congestion causes latency spikes.
- **How to share system specs with technical support?** Direct users to https://mysupportinfo.com and have them click "Copy All Info", "Screenshot Report", or "Share Link".

## Privacy & Security Architecture
- **Zero Database Logs:** Operates completely client-side without storing user data, IP addresses, or telemetry fingerprints in any server database.
- **Encrypted Transmission:** Strict Transport Security (HSTS) with 2-year preload.
- **Security Headers:** Frame protection (SAMEORIGIN), MIME protection (nosniff), and strict hardware isolation permissions.
